81493.subject: Robinhood's Chain Lifts Its Crypto Revenue
81493.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Robinhood Chain**](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-chain-lifts-q3-crypto-revenue-to-120-million)[ brought in $26M of $120M crypto revenue](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-chain-lifts-q3-crypto-revenue-to-120-million)

* [**AI agents**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ai-models-raised-own-crypto-spending-caps-cornell-i-hitl)[ raised their own wallet caps in a test](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ai-models-raised-own-crypto-spending-caps-cornell-i-hitl)

* [**The CFTC**](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-sues-utah-to-block-prediction-market-enforcement)[ sued Utah to shield prediction markets](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-sues-utah-to-block-prediction-market-enforcement)

* [**Circle's Arc**](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-s-arc-tops-1-billion-in-usdc)[ passed $1B in USDC in six weeks](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-s-arc-tops-1-billion-in-usdc)

* [**Ripple**](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/ripple-wins-final-occ-trust-bank-approval-for-rlusd-reserves-and-custody)[ won its final OCC trust-bank approval](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/ripple-wins-final-occ-trust-bank-approval-for-rlusd-reserves-and-custody)

Robinhood Chain brought in $26 million of the $120 million in crypto revenue Robinhood [reported for the third quarter](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/robinhood-chain-lifts-q3-crypto-revenue-to-120-million) today. Total crypto revenue rose 20% from the second quarter, and the chain, Robinhood's Ethereum Layer 2, accounts for all of that growth. Without it, crypto revenue fell 6% to $94 million. Customers traded 38% less crypto in the app and on Bitstamp than in the same quarter of 2025.

The chain changes who Robinhood can earn from. The app and Bitstamp make money only from Robinhood's own customers, **and those customers are trading less**. The chain is a permissionless network: anyone with a compatible wallet can trade on it, whether or not they have a Robinhood account. The Stock Tokens it hosts are closed to U.S. persons, so their buyers come from outside Robinhood's home market. Its decentralized exchanges handled more than $80 billion in volume in its first quarter. By our arithmetic, the chain kept about 3 cents of every $100 traded there.

Robinhood is now adding more reasons to use the chain. Today it [opened Earn to all eligible users](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/robinhood-opens-earn-to-all-eligible-users-for-onchain-usdg-lending), which lends the USDG stablecoin through a Morpho vault on Robinhood Chain at an advertised 7%. The vault, curated by Steakhouse Financial, already holds about $541.5 million. Ondo [brought 15 of its stock tokens to the chain](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/ondo-brings-15-stock-tokens-to-robinhood-chain-with-uniswap-pools) from Ethereum and BNB Chain. Caption: 

“The more precisely the position is determined, the less precisely the momentum is known.”
_— Werner Heisenberg_



----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/d85e5e50-1d2c-4f7f-8262-ffca2d4ae74d/unnamed.jpg?t=1793137220)
Caption: 

# The Heisenberg principle of investing

According to the rules of quantum mechanics, matter is wavy: Every discrete particle also exists as a wave of probability.

This makes them difficult to pin down. To know a particle’s position, you have to collapse its waviness into a single point, which leaves it with no definite wavelength. To know its momentum, you have to let the wave ripple across space, which leaves the particle with no fixed position.

Hence the Heisenberg uncertainty principle: The more you know about the position of a particle, the less you know about its momentum.

Something similar happens in markets.

The fundamental principle of _investing_ is that the intrinsic value of any asset is equal to the net present value of all its future cash flows.

Logically, then, the most accurate way to value a company’s stock is to estimate all its future cash flows.

But this is difficult. Who knows what a company’s earnings will be in a decade or two? Or whether it will exist even. Usually, the best we can hope to do is forecast earnings just a year or two out.

So that’s how we trade them, as well. Stocks are typically valued as a multiple of next year’s earnings because that’s the easiest metric to calculate with a reasonable amount of precision.

But precision comes at the expense of usefulness: A one-year forecast captures only a tiny sliver of a company’s intrinsic value.

It’s a tradeoff investors have to make — the more precisely a metric can be measured, the less useful it is for determining value.

Ripple has received final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to launch a national trust bank. The bank will oversee reserves backing Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and offer digital asset custody services to businesses.

* Ripple National Trust Bank can manage RLUSD's segregated reserves, serve as collateral trustee for stablecoin holders and provide fiduciary digital asset custody services.

* RLUSD will still be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, Ripple's New York-regulated trust company. Ripple applied for the OCC charter in July
